description: This file defines API endpoints for managing comments in a project management platform. It includes functions to create new comments and retrieve comments for a specific task, utilizing FastAPI to handle HTTP requests and PostgreSQL for database operations.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Schema representing a comment, including attributes like id, task_id, body, and created_by.

methods.name: str _assert_task_in_org(conn, task_id: str, org_id: str)
methods.description: Verifies that a task exists within an organization and returns the associated project ID.

methods.name: Comment create_comment( data: CommentCreate = Body(...), ctx=Depends(require_org_role("member")), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a comment on a specific task, requiring member-level permissions.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments(task_id: str, ctx=Depends(require_org_role("viewer")))
methods.description: API endpoint to list all comments for a specific task, requiring viewer-level permissions.

ctags.name: _assert_task_in_org
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_task_in_org(conn, task_id: str, org_id: str) -> str:$/
